name: gitignore-cmake-scripts
title: Stop .gitignore from hiding new CMake scripts under cmake/
issue: Add `!cmake/*.cmake` next to the existing `!text/cmake/*.cmake` exception in .gitignore (the `*.cmake` rule currently hides new files in cmake/, which is why cmake/PhysXLinuxHashes.cmake had to be force-added in PR #120). Change only .gitignore; keep its line endings and layout; add a one-line comment. Verify with git check-ignore that cmake/PhysXLinuxHashes.cmake (tracked) and a hypothetical untracked cmake/Foo.cmake are NOT ignored, while generated files such as CMakeCache.txt, cmake_install.cmake and build output stay ignored, and that `git status` on the branch shows nothing new unexpectedly untracked. CI must stay green (no code change).
acceptance: git check-ignore shows cmake/*.cmake not ignored and generated CMake files still ignored
